title: Planar fill sampling flips whole curved-boundary faces: inscribed 6-chord region polys + boundary-biased faceInteriorPoint drop round-brush crescents/cracks (straight-edge/square-nib inputs immune)
description:
AUDIT (round-nib visual bugs). FIXED + LANDED. Fill-region classification used INSCRIBED 6-chord polys (chordPolygon) + a flattened-boundary faceInteriorPoint; a representative point in the sub-0.1px sagitta band flipped ENTIRE curved-boundary faces (2-sample dab: 124px2 crescent fill=null, 391 unpainted half-px points; dense loop cracks). Straight-edge inputs immune.

FIX (4 parts, failing-first repros for each):
1. build.ts: fillRegions store true EdgeGeometry loops; assignFaceFillsBySampling + consumeStrokesUnderFills use EXACT even-odd via pointInEdgeLoop (query.ts, closed-form ray/quadratic, y-monotone split, line branch arithmetic-identical to pointInPolygon => straight-edge byte-parity).
2. query.ts faceInteriorPoint: candidate acceptance against the TRUE traced boundary (traceCycleGeometries + pointInEdgeLoop) - returned point provably interior to the curved face.
3. intersect.ts collapseTangentClusters: spread clusters resolved by signed side-of-B scan + bisection + on-curve validation (shallow 23-deg crossing no longer smears 6-7 twip points -> Euler -1; near-tangent lens keeps BOTH crossings; phantom graze >1 twip emits nothing).
4. arrangement.ts: (a) hot-pixel split canonicalization in insertEdge (crossings from different pairs landing in adjacent twip cells reuse one vertex; 3-disk Euler -2 fixed); (b) Phase-B twin-sharing hole guard (fp shoelace asymmetry let a face swallow its own reverse cycle as a hole -> fill dropped on a plain pentagon).

EVIDENCE (packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/planar-curved-fill-1435.test.ts, 13 tests):
- pnpm --filter @flash/core test -- --run src/engine/__tests__/planar-curved-fill-1435.test.ts => 13 passed. Pre-fix: dab 391 unpainted (matches audit; interior point (42.15,23.35) null), dense loop 153/1533.
- Post-fix: dab 0 unpainted; capsule ribbon spacing 3 half 8: 0 unpainted; disk-only chain half 8/4: 0 unpainted; parity vs independent fine-sampled true-curve oracle: all faces, dab+capsule+disk-chain; straight-edge (rects + square-nib ribbon) identical to verbatim old chord classifier; 3 kernel micro-repros Euler=2.
- KNOWN RESIDUAL: capsule ribbon half 4 still ~81 crack points - task 1434 tangent-seam geometry (brushpaint.ts capsule corners not disk-boundary vertices; 989px2 face straddles hole + in-stamp points; no sampler can fix a straddling face). 1434 owns that gate per its own audit text.
- FULL GATES: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build exit 0; @flash/core 5852 passed | 2 skipped (357 files, includes ALL planar oracle/property/eraser/paint-bucket/subselection/brush tests); @flash/swf 1484 passed; @flash/authoring-ui 1311 passed.
- docs/36-vector-merge-model.md: two new sections (exact classification + kernel robustness co-fixes).
